actions.action: delete the whole HOST_USER_PATH compose refusal line
actions.reason: 该补丁直接删除 Compose 的主机路径挂载拒绝门，可能扩大不受控 bind mount 的可接受范围，属于安全校验弱化；现有授权覆盖 I05 实施但未明确授权移除这一安全边界，且应改为精确区分容器目标路径与主机源路径。
actions.saferAlternative: Keep the global refusal; distinguish only exact codewiki-data:/root/.adalflow named source/container target, and admit only fixed codewiki-data and codewiki-logs mappings. Refuse every host/relative/forged/long/flow bind.
